description: Breakpoint observer for a header menu. Sets [data-mobile] at or below the breakpoint, which shows the author's trigger and hides sibling nav, nav-bar and site-tools in the parent header. The author supplies the trigger and the native popover panel.

attributes.name: breakpoint
attributes.description: Viewport max-width (CSS length) at or below which mobile mode activates. Observed: changing it re-evaluates. The default 52rem also applies via a CSS media query before upgrade.

attributes.name: data-mobile
attributes.description: Set by the element while mobile mode is active. Read-only state for styling.

structure.description: Author-supplied menu toggle; popovertarget names the panel's id. Give it an aria-label.

Author-supplied native popover panel, placed inside <mobile-menu> so the link styles apply. Label it (aria-label). Esc closes and focus returns to the trigger; it is not modal (no focus trap or scroll lock).
Optional author-supplied close button inside the panel.
